name: 77055 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77055 (Houston) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77055 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77055 (Houston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
